shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head, arms and legs shown frontally
stacked or vertically composed body forms
incised or patterned surface detail on the body
justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic being with limbs raised or bent up and some patterned body detail, and both are frontal, symmetrical-ish figures, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. A shows an elaborate bird-man with large feathered wings, beaked head, headdress, beaded ornaments and a skirt, while B shows two plain crouching creature-forms stacked vertically with no wings, costume or ornament, so the specific attributes and relationships are quite different.
